blocks.content:
The CVC has powers of a civil court while conducting inquiries. It can:
• Call for reports from government departments
• Examine witnesses
• Recommend disciplinary action
• Refer cases to the CBI
The CVC has powers of a civil court while conducting inquiries.

items: Exams often test whether CVC has powers of a Civil Court or Criminal Court—it exclusively holds powers of a Civil Court during inquiries.
Direct question alert: CVC has the authority to refer cases directly to the CBI for investigation.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The CVC is vested with the powers of a civil court while conducting inquiries.
It has the authority to call for reports from various government departments.
The CVC can examine witnesses and recommend disciplinary action against defaulting personnel.
It possesses the power to refer cases to the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) for further action.
